coach_says: TSB is -55.5 and Garmin reports UNPRODUCTIVE with declining fitness trend, so recovery takes absolute priority this week over the aerobic-high shortage flag. Tuesday's committed hard MTB group ride serves as the week's single quality/anaerobic session; every other ride is easy Zone 1-2 and gym load is cut to light maintenance only. Volume is trimmed across the board to restore TSB before reintroducing tempo/threshold work next week.

days.details:
Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 3x150m (easy/moderate alternating), 30 sec rest
Cooldown: 150m easy
Total: ~800m, kept easy - recovery focus given high fatigue, not a structured quality swim this week.

days.session: Morning Easy Spin + Evening Committed Hard MTB Group Ride
days.details:
Morning (45 min, before work): Zone 1-2 easy flat spin, low HR, purely aerobic - hills ride downgraded to easy given TSB -55.5, avoiding a true double-hard day.

Evening (60 min): Committed hard MTB group ride (non-negotiable) - Zone 3-5 technical effort, treated as this week's sole quality/anaerobic session. Ride the terrain as required by the group but don't chase extra Strava efforts - conserve where possible.

Full-body gentle flow: hip flexors, hamstrings, thoracic spine mobility, diaphragmatic breathing work. Mandatory easy/no-load day post Tuesday's double session per constraint - no cycling, no lifting.

days.session: Easy AM Spin + Light Recovery Strength (Workout A - reduced load)
days.details:
Before work (45 min): Zone 1-2 endurance spin, flat/rolling terrain, conversational effort.

Lunch (45 min) - Workout A, light/maintenance loading (RIR 3-4, no grinding reps):
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility

Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (light)
Bulgarian Split Squat 2x8 each leg
Chest Supported Row 3x10
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x10
Copenhagen Plank 2x20 sec
Dead Bug 2x8 each side

Main lifts: 2 min rest
Accessories: 60 sec rest

Goal: maintain strength/movement quality without adding systemic fatigue.

days.session: Steady Endurance Ride (volume reduced for recovery)
days.details:
90 min | Objective: Aerobic endurance, no intensity work this week
15 min Zone 1 warm-up
60 min Zone 2 steady
15 min Zone 1 cool-down

No tempo/threshold intervals despite aerobic-high shortage flag - recovery is prioritised this week.

120 min | Objective: Long aerobic endurance, fully Zone 1-2
20 min Zone 1 warm-up
80 min Zone 2 steady
20 min Zone 1 cool-down

Shorter than usual weekend long ride given accumulated fatigue - focus on smooth, low-stress aerobic volume.
Complete rest - no structured training. Prioritise sleep, hydration and nutrition given TSB -55.5 and Garmin UNPRODUCTIVE status. Optional short easy walk if desired, nothing more.
